description: Check required preliminary pages are present and in the order the Manual specifies.
suggestion: Arrange the preliminary pages in the Manual's order: Title Page, Certification, Approval, Dedication (if any), Acknowledgements, Abstract, Table of Contents, Lists of Tables/Figures/Plates where applicable, List of Abbreviations, List of Symbols where applicable, Operational Definition of Terms.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section A 1, pp. 1-4.

description: Check Chapter One segments required by the Manual (Rationale, Justification, Research Questions and Hypotheses are 'where applicable').
required: Aim/Purpose of the Study || Aim of the Study || Purpose of the Study || Aim and Objectives of the Study || Aims and Objectives of the Study || Purpose and Objectives of the Study
Research Objectives || Objectives of the Study || Aim and Objectives of the Study || Aims and Objectives of the Study || Purpose and Objectives of the Study
suggestion: Add the missing Chapter One segments required by the Manual. Aim/Purpose and Research Objectives may appear as separate headings or under one combined heading such as 'Aim and Objectives of the Study' (accepted for this project by the supervisor); objectives must be itemised.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section B 2.1, pp. 5-8.

description: Check Chapter Two segments required by the Manual (Conceptual Framework, Theoretical Framework and Theoretical Studies are 'where applicable').
suggestion: Add the missing Chapter Two segments required by the Manual. Empirical studies must be synthesised under sub-headings, not presented abstract by abstract.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section B 2.2, pp. 8-9.

description: Check Computer Science Chapter Three required sections.
required: 3.2.2.2 High Level Model of the Proposed System
suggestion: Check the Chapter Three structure against the departmental guide. Include suitable labelled diagrams according to the methodology adopted (for example DFD/ERD for SSADM or use-case and interaction diagrams for OOADM).
manual_reference: Computer Science MSc/PhD Documentation Format (chapter structure for Chapters 3-5).

description: Check Chapter Four sections. Items the format marks '(if any)' or 'choose those applicable' (4.4.x, 4.5, 4.6) are not required.
suggestion: Verify Chapter Four against the departmental outline. Include only applicable optional subsections, but ensure relevant design, implementation, testing and security material is documented.
manual_reference: Computer Science MSc/PhD Documentation Format (chapter structure for Chapters 3-5).

description: Check Computer Science Chapter Five and contribution-to-knowledge section.
suggestion: Check the Chapter Five outline. The departmental guide says Contribution to Knowledge is included for MSc and PhD works.
manual_reference: Computer Science MSc/PhD Documentation Format (chapter structure for Chapters 3-5).

description: Check page margins in every section: left 2.5 cm; right, top and bottom 2.0 cm.
suggestion: Set the left margin to 2.5 cm and the right, top and bottom margins to 2.0 cm (Layout > Margins > Custom).
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section D 4.1(iv)-(v), p. 35.

description: Check that body text uses Times New Roman (effective font, including style-inherited fonts).
suggestion: Set body text to Times New Roman, preferably by modifying the Normal style so the change applies everywhere.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section D 4.1(i), p. 35.

description: Check that body text is 12 pt (effective size, including style-inherited sizes).
suggestion: Use 12-point body text as specified by the departmental guide, preferably by modifying the Normal style.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section D 4.1(i), p. 35.

description: Check for a References section.
suggestion: Include a References section and list works cited in the thesis according to the UNIZIK citation and referencing rules.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section C, pages 21 onward; Computer Science Documentation Format, page 2.

description: Check whether author-year citations are detected.
suggestion: No author-year citations were detected automatically. Review citations manually; this may be a parser limitation and does not prove citations are absent.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section C, pages 15–21.

description: Check that detected citations have likely matching reference-list entries.
suggestion: Check whether this in-text citation has a corresponding reference-list entry. Matching is heuristic and can produce false positives.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section C, pages 21 onward.

description: Check that body text (chapters) uses double (2.0) line spacing.
suggestion: Set chapter text to double (2.0) line spacing (Paragraph > Line spacing > Double). The Manual specifies 1.5 only for the title page, certification, approval, dedication, acknowledgements, abstract and cover page.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section D 4.1(i), p. 35; Section B 2.1-2.5.

description: Check that every section uses A4 paper.
suggestion: Set the paper size to A4 (21.0 x 29.7 cm) for the whole document (Layout > Size > A4).
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section D 4.1(iii), p. 35.

description: Check that pages are numbered at the bottom right, with Roman numerals for preliminary pages and Arabic numerals for the main body.
suggestion: Insert page numbers in the footer, right-aligned. Use lower-case Roman numerals (i, ii) for preliminary pages and Arabic numerals (1, 2) from Chapter One; add a section break after the preliminary pages to switch styles.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section D 4.1(vii), p. 35.

description: Check that parenthetical citations separate author and year with a comma.
suggestion: Place a comma between author and year, e.g. (Okeke, 2014).
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section C 3.1.1, p. 15.

description: Check that two-author citations use 'and' rather than '&'.
suggestion: Join author names with 'and' rather than '&'.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section C 3.1.2(i), pp. 15-16.

description: Check that every reference-list entry is cited in the text.
suggestion: For science, education, management and social-science theses, only works actually cited may be listed under References (Arts disciplines may use a Bibliography). Cite this work or remove it. Matching is heuristic (first author surname and year).
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section C 3.3.1, p. 21.

description: Check that references are in alphabetical order by author surname.
suggestion: Sort the reference list alphabetically by first author's surname.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section C 3.3.1, p. 21.

description: Check abstract length: at most 300 words (MSc) or 500 words (PhD), in one block paragraph.
suggestion: Shorten the abstract to the limit for your degree (300 words for a Master's thesis, 500 for a Doctoral dissertation) and write it as one block paragraph.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section A 1.6, p. 4.

description: Check that typed heading numbers run in sequence within each chapter (e.g. 2.3 is followed by 2.4, not 2.5).
suggestion: Renumber headings so each level counts up without gaps or repeats.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section D 4.2, pp. 35-36 (numbered four-tier headings).

description: Check that works cited together are in alphabetical order, e.g. (Nkamigbo, 2018; Nwankwo, 1998; Okoye, 2005).
suggestion: Arrange citations that appear together in alphabetical order by author.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section C 3.1.2(iv), p. 16.

description: Check heading formats: chapter number and title centred, bold, uppercase; level two bold title case; level three bold sentence case; level four bold italic sentence case; at most four levels.
suggestion: Format headings as the Manual specifies: chapter number and title centred, bold, UPPERCASE; level two (4.1) bold, flush left, Title Case; level three (4.1.1) bold, flush left, only the first word capitalised; level four (4.1.1.1) bold italic, flush left, only the first word capitalised. Use no more than four levels.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section D 4.2, pp. 35-37.

description: Check for standard Latin abbreviations (e.g., i.e., etc., viz., cf., ibid.), which the Manual does not allow in the text (except et al.).
suggestion: Replace Latin abbreviations with English words (for example: 'such as', 'that is', 'and so on'). Only 'et al.' (and 'vs.' for Law) is permitted, in italics.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section D 4.8(ii), p. 41.

description: Check numeral conventions: no ordinal suffixes on dates or positions (15th, 5th), no apostrophe in decades (1990's), no spelled number mixed with %.
suggestion: Write dates as '15 December, 2005' (no 'th'); write positions in words ('fifth'); write decades as '1990s'; write '90%' or 'ninety percent', not 'ninety %'.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section D 4.5(a)-(c), pp. 39-40.

description: Check that Chapter Four is written in the third person.
suggestion: Rewrite first-person statements (I, we, our, my, us) in the third person (for example 'the system', 'the researcher').
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section B 2.4.1.1, p. 12.

description: Check that each acronym is spelled out on first use, followed by the abbreviation in parentheses.
suggestion: On first use, spell the term out in full and put the abbreviation in parentheses, e.g. Natural Language Processing (NLP). Afterwards the abbreviation may be used alone.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section D 4.8(i), p. 41.

description: British-English spelling and grammar check (LanguageTool, optional).
suggestion: Review the highlighted wording. Theses must be written in British English.
manual_reference: UNIZIK Manual of Style (2019), Section A 1, p. 1 (British English).
